router.post('/notes/:id/attachments', requireAuth, (req, res) => { upload.single('file')(req, res, (err) => { if (err) return res.status(400).json({ error: err.message || 'Error uploading file.' }); if (!req.file) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'A file is required.' }); const noteId = parseInt(req.params.id, 10); const note = getNoteById(noteId, req.user!.id); if (!note) { fs.unlinkSync(path.join(uploadsDir, req.file.filename)); return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Note not found or permission denied.' }); } const attachment = addNoteAttachment({ note_id: noteId, user_id: req.user!.id, original_name: req.file.originalname, file_name: req.file.filename, mime_type: req.file.mimetype, file_size: req.file.size }); return res.status(201).json({ attachment, downloadUrl: `/api/notes/${noteId}/attachments/${attachment.id}/download` }); }); });
